consumer: law_set dataset governance chain (gate + bundle export + distribution consumers)
title: Evorule Law entry (law_set dataset payload)
description: Law entry payload contract for law_set datasets. A law states an equation identity (equation-always-true semantics: the equation separator is compiled to an equality comparison downstream); condition/then decision semantics belong to rule_set entries and are structurally excluded here. Nine semantic elements: formula / symbols / si_units / domain / solvable / derivation / tier / max_version_depth / monotone_form. Entry-level admission (machine gate) additionally requires all nine elements present and rejects bare equation separators (a separator with an empty side).

max_version_depth.description: Version-chain height h_p (finiteness declaration): required, integer >= 1

monotone_form.description: Monotone-form declaration: must be true (non-monotone laws are rejected; resubmit as a time-anchored rewrite)

time_anchor.description: Time-anchored rewrite declaration anchor (optional; required non-empty when the formula hits a negation construct)
